issues.title: B-REG-01 [CRITICAL] No over-quota detection at ad creation (TC-02 FAIL)
issues.body:
## Description
When a vendor is at quota limit (e.g. 3/3 for Starter), creating another ad goes through normal flow instead of being stopped/paused.

## Expected behavior
- Yellow warning banner on ad form: "Has alcanzado el límite del plan…"
- Redirect to `/success?id_product=X&paused=1`
- Message: "Anuncio creado en pausa"
- CTAs: "Ir a Mis anuncios" + "Ver planes superiores"
- `product.active = 0`

## Actual behavior
- No warning banner on form
- Normal redirect `/anuncio-publicado?id_product=X` (no paused flag)
- Message: "pendiente de revisión"
- Standard CTAs
- Ad gets PUBLISHED after moderator cron runs

## Steps to reproduce
1. Login as vendor with Starter plan (3 active ads max)
2. Create 3 ads → reach 3/3 quota
3. Go to `/module/zonacncproductadd/ads` → no warning
4. Fill form and submit → ad created normally
5. Run moderator cron → ad gets approved and PUBLISHED (should be paused)

## Environment
- new.zonacnc.com
- AUTO_APPROVE=0
- Account: qatester-reg20260506@zonacnc.com
- Test date: 2026-05-06

issues.title: B-REG-02 [CRITICAL] Moderator cron activates ads ignoring quota limits (TC-07 FAIL)
issues.body:
## Description
When moderator cron runs and a vendor is already at quota (3/3), newly approved submissions should be left in paused state (product.active=0). Instead, ALL approved submissions are activated regardless of quota.

## Expected behavior
- Submission → approved
- product.active = 0 (paused due to over-quota)
- Email: "Tu anuncio fue aprobado pero está en pausa"
- Log: "onApproved: vendor over-quota — submission … queda en pausa"

## Actual behavior
- Submission → approved
- product.active = 1 (incorrectly activated)
- Email (likely): "Tu anuncio ha sido publicado"
- No over-quota check

## Steps to reproduce
1. Vendor at 3/3 active quota
2. Create 4th ad → pending review
3. Run moderator cron
4. All ads activated and published (4/3 active)

## Environment
- new.zonacnc.com
- AUTO_APPROVE=0
- Account: qatester-reg20260506@zonacnc.com
- Test date: 2026-05-06

issues.title: B-REG-03 [HIGH] Toggle active/pause returns malformed JSON (409 with HTML)
issues.body:
## Description
When calling the toggle-active endpoint, the HTTP 409 response contains malformed JSON. The response body appears to contain HTML (`&` etc) instead of proper JSON, causing frontend parsing error: `Unexpected token '&'`.

## Expected behavior
```json
{"error":"No puedes activar más anuncios. Tu plan permite 3 activos y ya tienes 3.","quota":{"current":3,"limit":3,"is_unlimited":false},"pricing_url":"…"}
```

## Actual behavior
- HTTP 409 returned
- Response body contains HTML/vendor text instead of JSON
- Console: `Unexpected token '&'`
- No user-visible error message (empty alert element)

## Steps to reproduce
1. Vendor at 3/3 quota
2. Have a disabled/paused ad
3. Click "Activate" on /myads
4. Check network tab → 409 response
5. Check console for JSON parse error

## Environment
- new.zonacnc.com
- Account: qatester-reg20260506@zonacnc.com
- Test date: 2026-05-06

issues.title: B-REG-05 [HIGH] Quota counter does not update via AJAX after toggle
issues.body:
## Description
After toggling an ad's active state (Disable/Activate), the quota counter ("Anuncios activos: X / 3") does not update in the DOM. It only shows the correct value after a full page refresh.

## Expected behavior
- After Disable: counter drops from 3/3 to 2/3 immediately
- After Activate: counter rises from 2/3 to 3/3 immediately

## Actual behavior
- Counter stays at previous value
- Only refreshes after page reload

## Steps to reproduce
1. Go to /myads
2. Click Disable on a published ad
3. Observe quota counter → unchanged
4. Refresh page → shows correct value

## Environment
- new.zonacnc.com
- Account: qatester-reg20260506@zonacnc.com
- Test date: 2026-05-06

issues.title: B-REG-07 [MEDIUM] DISABLED badge contradicts PUBLISHED status on same ad
issues.body:
## Description
On /myads, some ads show a "DISABLED" badge but their status text says "PUBLISHED". This UI inconsistency confuses users.

## Expected behavior
Badge should match actual status:
- DISABLED → "Disabled" or "Paused"
- PUBLISHED → "Active" or "Published"

## Actual behavior
Ad #13071 (Mazak Quick Turn) shows:
- Badge: DISABLED (red/gray)
- Status line: PUBLISHED

## Steps to reproduce
1. Create ads and toggle some to disabled
2. Observe badge vs status text mismatch

## Environment
- new.zonacnc.com
- Account: qatester-reg20260506@zonacnc.com
- Test date: 2026-05-06

issues.title: B-REG-08 [MEDIUM] Success message always shows "pending review" regardless of auto-approve
issues.body:
## Description
After submitting an ad, the success page always displays "Tu anuncio está pendiente de revisión" even when AUTO_APPROVE could bypass this.

## Expected behavior (from regression book)
"Tu anuncio … ya está publicado y visible para los compradores"

## Actual behavior
"Tu anuncio … está pendiente de revisión. Te notificaremos por email cuando sea aprobado."

## Notes
- AUTO_APPROVE=0 but message should differentiate between auto-approve and manual moderation flows
- The message is inconsistent with actual behavior (ads DO get approved by moderator cron)

## Environment
- new.zonacnc.com
- Account: qatester-reg20260506@zonacnc.com
- Test date: 2026-05-06

issues.title: B-REG-09 [LOW] Enforcequota shows "sync_failed:plan_not_loaded" for subscription 1
issues.body:
## Description
When running the enforcequota cron, the response shows a subscription (id_subscription: 1) with stripe_sync status "sync_failed:plan_not_loaded". This suggests a Stripe-to-local plan mapping failure.

## Cron output
```json
{
  "id_subscription": 1,
  "status": "applied",
  "new_plan": 0,
  "new_quota": 0,
  "stripe_sync": "sync_failed:plan_not_loaded"
}
```

## Steps to reproduce
1. Run `curl https://new.zonacnc.com/module/zonacncplans/cron?token=...&action=enforcequota`
2. Check details for sync_failed entries

## Environment
- new.zonacnc.com
- Test date: 2026-05-06
